calls.statement:
SELECT 'sales' t, min(sale_date) mn, max(sale_date) mx, max(etl_loaded_at) ld, count(*) n FROM fact_sales_line
UNION ALL SELECT 'dim_date', min(calendar_date), max(calendar_date), NULL, count(*) FROM dim_date
UNION ALL SELECT 'stg_sales', min(sale_date), max(sale_date), max(etl_loaded_at), count(*) FROM stg_sales_line_load

SELECT f.sale_date, f.channel_code, f.staff_purchase_flag, count(*) lines, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) dist_lines, sum(f.quantity) units, sum(f.net_amount) net, min(f.etl_loaded_at) mn_ld, max(f.etl_loaded_at) mx_ld, min(f.quantity) minq
FROM fact_sales_line f
WHERE f.store_key IN (SELECT store_key FROM dim_store WHERE store_id=131) AND f.product_key IN (SELECT product_key FROM dim_product WHERE sku=101624) AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-21' AND DATE '2026-10-04'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT 'dup_ids_fact' k, count(*) n FROM (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date>=DATE '2026-09-28' GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'stg_in_fact', count(*) FROM stg_sales_line_load s JOIN fact_sales_line f USING (sales_line_id)
UNION ALL SELECT 'stg_rows_store131_sku', count(*) FROM stg_sales_line_load s WHERE store_key=37 AND product_key=1702
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_receipt_line', count(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id,line_no FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date>=DATE '2026-09-28' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)

calls.statement:
SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.sale_date, f.channel_id, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.standard_cost, r.return_line_id, r.return_date, r.quantity_returned, r.reason_code, (SELECT count(*) FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id=131 AND c.closure_end_date>=DATE '2026-09-21') closures
FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON r.sales_line_id=f.sales_line_id
WHERE f.store_key=37 AND f.product_key=1702 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04' ORDER BY f.sale_date

SELECT 101624 AS sku, p.product_name, s.store_id, s.store_name, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, sum(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id = 131 AND p.sku = 101624 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_week = 22
GROUP BY ALL
